scored_features.gate_reasoning: G1: NIHSS is listed in trial_measured_features so the feature is observed in the IST-3 dataset. G2: The hypothesis specifies concrete biological steps (penumbral salvage with reperfusion, infarct core size, and sICH risk tied to larger established infarcts) connecting NIHSS to differential alteplase effects. G3: The proposed mechanism implies true effect modification (patients with moderate NIHSS have more salvageable tissue and thus greater reperfusion benefit, while very severe NIHSS confers higher sICH risk and less salvageable tissue), so this is more than mere absolute-risk amplification. scored_features.justification: Decisive pass: G3 (causal plausibility) — NIHSS plausibly indexes salvageable penumbra versus large core and sICH risk, producing a true treatment-modifying mechanism that is supported by pooled trial literature and is operationalizable in practice.
